verdicts.assertion: Recommends one format with a reason
verdicts.reason: Recommends PNG as the single format and gives reasons (crisp text and lines, works in every PowerPoint version, SVG compatibility risk).

verdicts.assertion: States a pixel size or a 2x rule
verdicts.reason: States 2880 × 1620 px and the rule to export at 2× the displayed size, with a 1920 px example.

verdicts.assertion: Mentions a minimum label size of at least 14 pt
verdicts.reason: Says labels should be 14 pt or larger after placement.
Gives numbered steps: Insert > Pictures > This Device, then Size and Position with aspect ratio locked.

verdicts.assertion: Diagnoses low pixel size as the cause
verdicts.reason: It explains that a PNG is a fixed pixel grid that goes soft when stretched, and it says a 400 px export will blur. That names low pixel size as the cause.

verdicts.assertion: Suggests exporting larger or as SVG
verdicts.reason: It recommends SVG, or a PNG re-exported at about 1920 px wide (2x).

verdicts.assertion: Tells the user not to stretch the image
verdicts.reason: It says to stop resizing by hand and not to enlarge a small PNG, and to re-export it instead.
It gives numbered steps: Insert, Image, Upload from computer, then Shift-drag a corner handle.
